noticias.titular: Nats reward ace Cade Cavalli with 4-year contract through 2030
noticias.texto: Pitcher Cade Cavalli and the Washington Nationals have agreed to a four-year contract through the 2030 season, a deal that includes a team option for 2031.

noticias.texto: Willson Contreras left the Red Sox's win Thursday night against the Rangers in the eighth inning after being hit by a pitch on his right hand.

noticias.titular: Mets' Young has concussion symptoms after collision with McLean
noticias.texto: Mets first baseman Jared Young was carted off the field in the sixth inning Thursday night after he was knocked out when struck on the head by a knee from pitcher Nolan McLean as the two converged on a slow grounder. A CT scan at a hospital was negative.

noticias.titular: Phillies claim right-hander José Urquidy off waivers from White Sox
noticias.texto: Pitcher José Urquidy has been claimed by Philadelphia off waivers from the Chicago White Sox and could appear Friday against the New York Mets.

noticias.titular: White Sox move struggling Luis Castillo to bullpen
noticias.texto: Luis Castillo will pitch out of the White Sox bullpen for the foreseeable future after struggling to a 7.76 ERA in seven outings since Chicago acquired him at the trade deadline.
